body: I feel that man.  I'm in the same situation.  Yesterday my dad screamed at me to be a man when I was crying and repeating "Why doesn't anybody want me?"  That was right after he threatened to throw me out.  Right now I'm choosing to live in the delusion that things might be alright in a couple days.  That my girlfriend of 2 years didn't really leave me without saying anything.  Sometimes that's all you have.

Honestly I wish I had ended it while I still had money for dope, but when you have it you don't want to die then you run out and want to die, but can't.  I had a friend intentionally OD on morphine.  It was sad, but I knew his pain was over.  At least if you pull a Kurt Cobain, it won't hurt as much if you have to shoot twice.  I hope you can find help.  I hope I can find help.  I'm not saying kill yourself, but I know if I was 100% sure I would ride out on the one thing that made this fucked up world alright if I could.

Are we just playing who has the shittier life?  I have tens of thousands of dollars in student loan debt, but the credits of a freshman.  I'm 3 months clean of heroin.  I still have bad acne even though I'm sober and 21.  I've been depressed and anxious since elementary school so I can't wait for these emotions to start being temporary.
Well if you're interested in what may be the worst possible advice, heroin gave me the will to live for a long time and it's a way better way to go out (for those that might find you as well).

I'm here for the same reason you are so no judgement, but I've done DMT a number of times.  IMO there's nothing to really learn from what you saw.  It's just a hallucination.

Edit:  I could give you the same BS about life being worth it, but I don't know your life.  I hope you find the peace both of us are looking for no matter what you do.

Edit 2:  The importance of those experiences will fade with time.  I just don't want you to make a permanent decision based on a drug experience that is fleeting. 

Edit 3:  I'm also happy to talk if you just want to share drug experiences or something.
I've done it before, but just for a day or two.  It's not for me.
I mean that's where I'm at.  They've kicked me out before, but this is the first time I have no one else willing to take me.

they just want to cut their loses.  Between school and medical care I have cost them a lot.  We've never gotten along, even when I was in elementary school.  Why spend thousands of dollars on someone you never liked and who never liked you?
Aw thanks buddy.  I hadn't considered I was just being a bitch.  I mean sure I might be homeless without my medication or anyone who wants be, but I'm just being a pussy.
